evidence.trustReason: Given: both historical status files decode without run or unit tags, title, or aliveAt. When: real taskView actors and OpenTUI renders exercise all seven designs. Then: still liveness is asserted against a fresh-heartbeat control; each rendered design has the exact muted fallback line. And: independent glyph and label expectations cover Ledger and Ticker rows, Gantt right-hand states, and each selected Dock and HUD state; Matrix has glyph-only task rows, and Board has no cards. All six Board columns are zero and cardless; each visible trusted count is exactly 0/6, no stopped count or shared STOPPED group appears. The 4 focused tests pass with 221 assertions, closing D20.
